findings.message: Timer expression "${dateTime().plusDays(1).toDate()}" was not translated: "dateTime" is a Camunda 7 engine object with no Camunda 8 counterpart.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite it as a FEEL expression returning an ISO 8601 duration, date-time or cycle.

findings.message: Cron cycle "0 0 9 * * ?" uses Camunda 7's Quartz-style syntax.
findings.suggestion: Check it against Camunda 8's cron syntax, or use an ISO 8601 repeating interval.

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.
